sections.h2: Kashmir's saffron output has fallen 68% in about two decades

chart.title: Kashmir saffron output fell from 8 tonnes to 2.6 tonnes on one accounting
chart.sub: Metric tonnes produced, FY2010-11 and FY2023-24.
chart.source: National Geographic; Dialogue Earth; Greater Kashmir.

sections.means: The post attributes the fall mainly to erratic rainfall and lost insulating snowfall, not to any failure of demand or policy.
sections.todo: Reconcile the two tonnage series before using either figure in a policy case.

sections.h2: Indoor saffron packs more yield into each square metre of floor

chart.title: Indoor aeroponic beds yield 4-5 grams per square metre, against 0.5-2 in the field
chart.sub: Grams of dried saffron per square metre, as reported for one Kerala operation.

sections.means: Reported densities run 20-30 corms per square metre in the field against 200-300 indoors, from one Kerala operation graded moderate-to-strong rather than audited.
sections.todo: Measure yield in a Kashmir-sourced trial, such as the 10×10 foot NABARD-farmer room, before scaling the claim.

sections.h2: Coir exports climbed to $455 million in FY25 from $360 million

chart.title: Coir and coir-product exports rose from $360 million in FY24 to $455 million in FY25

sections.means: Coir pith alone carried 59.6% of FY25 export value, making coco peat the largest coir category.
sections.todo: Check whether the 62.9% rise in April-July FY26 holds for the full year before planning around it.
